Question 1: Is EMT correlated with tissue site? Within or across patients?
- Statistical test: one-way ANOVA, or 2-way ANOVA or linear models
- P-value=0.307. However, EMT score correlates with patient_id, need to normalize
```{r}
oc_avg <- readRDS("~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/Garcia_human_oc_scRNAseq/oc_sub.average.rds")
# Use sample ID to get tissue site and add to oc_avg metadata
oc_sub_df <- as.data.frame(oc_sub@meta.data)
sample_site <- oc_sub_df[c("spectrum_sample_id","tumor_supersite")]
oc_avg$tumor_supersite <- sample_site[match(colnames(oc_avg),sample_site$spectrum_sample_id),]$tumor_supersite
# Move Pathway scores to metadata
progeny_scores_df <- as.data.frame(t(GetAssayData(oc_avg, slot="data",assay = "progeny")))
oc_avg <- AddMetaData(oc_avg, progeny_scores_df, col.name=colnames(progeny_scores_df))
# 1-way ANOVA EMT vs tumor_supersite
emt.aov <- aov(EMT.score ~ tumor_supersite, data=oc_avg@meta.data)
summary(emt.aov)
```
Now, let's test whether EMT.scores, centered across each patient, is correlated with tumor site.
```{r}
# Center EMT.score across each patient
colnames(oc_avg@meta.data)[1] <- "patient_id"
oc_avg_df <- as.data.frame(oc_avg@meta.data)
emt_mean <- oc_avg_df %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(EMT.score), list(EMT.mean = mean))
oc_avg_df$EMT.mean <- emt_mean[match(oc_avg_df$patient_id,emt_mean$patient_id),]$EMT.mean
oc_avg$centered.EMT <- oc_avg_df$EMT.score-oc_avg_df$EMT.mean
emt.centered.aov <- aov(centered.EMT ~ tumor_supersite, data=oc_avg@meta.data)
summary(emt.centered.aov)
```
Linear model: EMT ~ tumor_site, patient_id
```{r}
lm_emt <- lm(formula = EMT.score ~ tumor_supersite + patient_id, data=oc_avg@meta.data)
summary(lm_emt)
# Make boxplot for visualization
ggboxplot(oc_avg@meta.data, x="tumor_supersite",y="EMT.score", color="tumor_supersite",add="jitter",palette="Set2") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=0.5,hjust=0.5))
```

Caculate t cell percentage of total t cells per sample.
```{r}
sample_cluster_sub<- as.data.frame.matrix(table(tcells$spectrum_sample_id,tcells$cluster_label_sub))
t.cluster_sub.frac <- sample_cluster_sub/rowSums(sample_cluster_sub)
sample_cluster<- as.data.frame.matrix(table(tcells$spectrum_sample_id,tcells$cluster_label))
t.cluster.frac <- sample_cluster/rowSums(sample_cluster)
```
```{r}
oc_avg_df <- as.data.frame(oc_avg@meta.data)
write.table(oc_avg_df,"C:/Users/William Mitchell/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/Garcia_human_oc_scRNAseq/OC_avg_df.txt", sep="\t")
# Calculate correlation between sample EMT.score and t.cluster.frac
add_emt <- function(t.cluster_sub.frac, oc_avg_df){
  t.cluster_sub.subset <- t.cluster_sub.frac[rownames(t.cluster_sub.frac) %in% rownames(oc_avg_df),]
  t.cluster_sub.subset$EMT.score <- oc_avg_df[match(rownames(t.cluster_sub.subset),rownames(oc_avg_df)),]$EMT.score
  t.cluster_sub.subset$EMT.centered <- oc_avg_df[match(rownames(t.cluster_sub.subset),rownames(oc_avg_df)),]$centered.EMT
  t.cluster_sub.subset$tumor_supersite <- oc_avg_df[match(rownames(t.cluster_sub.subset),rownames(oc_avg_df)),]$tumor_supersite
  return(t.cluster_sub.subset)
}
t.cluster_sub.subset <- add_emt(t.cluster_sub.frac, oc_avg_df)
t.cluster.subset <- add_emt(t.cluster.frac, oc_avg_df)
```
```{r}

lm_emt.tcluster <- lm(formula= EMT.score ~.,data=t.cluster.subset)
summary(lm_emt.tcluster)
```
```{r}
lm_emt.tsub <- lm(formula= EMT.score ~.,data=t.cluster_sub.subset)
summary(lm_emt.tsub)
```

Now, let's plot Linear Model results of EMT vs. T cell subset infiltration
```{r}
plot_lm <- function(lm_emt.tcluster){
lm_emt.tcluster_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(summary(lm_emt.tcluster)$coef)
colnames(lm_emt.tcluster_df)[4] <- "p_value"
lm_emt.tcluster_df$label <- rownames(lm_emt.tcluster_df)
# Add labels and axes
ggplot(lm_emt.tcluster_df, aes(x=Estimate, y=(-log10(p_value)), label=label))+
  geom_point()+geom_text_repel(max.overlaps=20)+
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05),linetype=2,color="blue")+
  geom_vline(xintercept=0)+ geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
  labs(x="Coefficient",title="EMT ~ t_subcluster% + tumor_supersite")+
  theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,size=15))
}
plot_lm(lm_emt.tsub)
```

```{r}
pathway_correlation<-function(t.avg.pathways,pathways){
out <- vector('list', length(pathways))
coef <- vector(length=length(pathways))
p_value <- vector(length=length(pathways))
r_squared <- vector(length=length(pathways))
for(i in 1:length(pathways)){
  #plot(t.avg.pathways$Epithelial,t.avg.pathways[[pathways[i]]],ylab=pathways[i])
  out[[i]] <- lm(paste(pathways[i],  '~', "EMT"),data=t.avg.pathways)
  print(summary(out[[i]]))
  coef[i] <- summary(out[[i]])$coef[2,1]
  p_value[i] <- summary(out[[i]])$coef[2,4]
  r_squared[i] <- summary(out[[i]])$r.squared
  res <- resid(out[[i]])
  #plot(fitted(out[[i]]),res,xlab=pathways[i],ylab="residuals")
  #abline(0,0)
}
emt.tpathways <- data.frame(coef, p_value,r_squared, pathways)

p1 <- ggplot(emt.tpathways, aes(x=coef, y=r_squared, label=pathways))+
  geom_point()+geom_text_repel(max.overlaps=20)+
  #geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05),linetype=2,color="blue")+
  geom_vline(xintercept=0)+ geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
  #xlim(c(-0.4,0.25))+
  labs(x="Coefficient",title="Tcell_Progeny_Pathways ~ Tumor_EMT_score")+
  theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,size=15))
print(p1)
return(emt.tpathways)
}
emt.tpathways<- pathway_correlation(t.avg.pathways, pathways[1:14])
```

```{r}
# Add patient_id as covariate using Linear-Mixed-Effects Model
pathways <- pathways[1:14]
out <- vector('list', length(pathways))
coef <- vector(length=length(pathways))
t_value <- vector(length=length(pathways))
p_Satt <- vector(length=length(pathways))
r2m <- vector(length=length(pathways))
r2c <- vector(length=length(pathways))
for(i in 1:length(pathways)){
  out[[i]] <- lmer(paste(pathways[i],  '~', "Mesenchymal + (1|patient_id)"),data=t.avg.pathways)
  coef[i] <- summary(out[[i]])$coef[2,1]
  t_value[i] <- summary(out[[i]])$coef[2,4]
  p_Satt[i] <- summary(out[[i]])$coef[2,5]
  r2m[i] <- r.squaredGLMM(out[[i]])[1,1]
  r2c[i] <- r.squaredGLMM(out[[i]])[1,2]
}
emt.tpathways <- data.frame(coef, t_value,p_Satt,r2m,r2c,pathways)
p1 <- ggplot(emt.tpathways, aes(x=coef, y=r2c, label=pathways))+
  geom_point()+geom_text_repel(max.overlaps=20)+
  #geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05),linetype=2,color="blue")+
  geom_vline(xintercept=0)+ geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
  labs(x="Coefficient",title="Tcell_Progeny_Pathways ~ Tumor_Mesenchymal_score+Patient_id")+
  theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,size=15))
print(p1)
```

```{r}
matchMMUsymbol<-function(human_symbol){
  dir = "~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/Documents/Code"
	map=read.table(file.path(dir,'codes_Davis/src/Mouse_Human_GeneIDs_sub.txt'),sep=' ',header=T)
	map_sor<-map[match(human_symbol,map$hsa_symbol),]
	mouse<-map_sor$mmu_symbol
	return(mouse)
}
# Find OC cluster markers
oc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(oc, only.pos = T, min.pct=0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
```

```{r}
top30 <- rownames(human_mouse_markers)[1:40]
human_mouse_markers <- mutate(human_mouse_markers, labels = ifelse(rownames(human_mouse_markers) %in% top30, rownames(human_mouse_markers),NA))
ggplot(human_mouse_markers, aes(x=BPPNM.lfc, y=avg_log2FC, color=cluster, label=labels))+geom_point()+ 
  geom_text_repel(aes(label=labels),size=3,color="Black")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,NA))+ 
  geom_vline(xintercept=0)+ geom_hline(yintercept=0)+
  labs(x="BPPNM in vivo bulk Mes vs. Epi LFC",y="Garcia scRNA-seq Cluster LFC",title="Mouse vs. Human EMT Marker Expression")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Paired")+
  theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,size=15))
```
```{r}
mouse_gene_sets = msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus")
mouse_hallmark <- mouse_gene_sets %>% dplyr::filter(gs_cat == "H") 
mouse_EMT <- mouse_hallmark[mouse_hallmark$gs_name %in% "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION", ]
human_mouse_new <- human_mouse_markers[!rownames(human_mouse_markers) %in% mouse_EMT$human_gene_symbol,]
human_mouse_new <- human_mouse_new[order(human_mouse_new$BPPNM.lfc,decreasing=T),]

immune_sets <- c('HALLMARK_COMPLEMENT', 'HALLMARK_IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING', 
                 'HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING', 'HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE', 
                 'HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE', 'HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE', 
                 'HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING', 'HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB')
mouse_himmune <- mouse_hallmark[mouse_hallmark$gs_name %in% immune_sets, ]
human_mouse_immune <- human_mouse_markers[rownames(human_mouse_markers) %in% mouse_himmune$human_gene_symbol,]
human_mouse_immune <- human_mouse_immune[order(human_mouse_immune$BPPNM.lfc,decreasing=T),]
deseq_subsets <- list("humanSC_mouseBulk_Markers"=human_mouse_markers, "human_mouse_notEMT_Hallmark"=human_mouse_new, "human_mouse_Immune_Hallmark"=human_mouse_immune)
write.xlsx(deseq_subsets,"~/Dropbox (Partners HealthCare)/Garcia_human_oc_scRNAseq/humansc_vs_mousebulk_genesets.xlsx",rowNames=T)
```

```{r}
# Run Harmony and UMAP
adnexa_sub <- RunHarmony(adnexa_sub, "orig.ident",reduction.use="pca", plot_convergence = T)
adnexa_sub <- FindNeighbors(adnexa_sub, reduction="harmony",dims = 1:50)
adnexa_sub <- FindClusters(adnexa_sub, reduction="harmony",resolution=0.3)
adnexa_sub <- RunUMAP(ovarian.integrated, reduction="harmony",dims=1:30, reduction.name = "umap_harmony")
p1 <- DimPlot(ovarian.integrated, reduction = "umap_harmony", group.by = "orig.ident")
p2 <- DimPlot(ovarian.integrated, reduction = "umap_harmony", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()
p1+p2
```
